background: Clydesdale Bank PLC is the operating bank of Virgin Money, now a subsidiary of Nationwide Building Society, funded by UK retail and business deposits and lending on mortgages, cards and to smaller companies.
synthesis: Only one of the three main agencies now rates the bank, at A+ on a stable outlook, after one of the three withdrew its rating on 29 Sep 2026. Capital is middling for UK mid-sized banks: CET1 of 14.3% is at the median, but leverage of 6.3% is below it. Liquidity is mixed, LCR of 164% below the median and NSFR of 143% in the top quarter. Leverage has risen 0.8 points since 31 Mar 2025, with figures only to 31 Mar 2026.
